name: travel and continuity
turns: I ask Cael and Kiera to come with me, then we all walk into The Copper Kettle tavern.
I ask Cael who was in the square when we left.
I say goodbye to Kiera and Cael and head north out of town alone along the road.
I look around. Who is with me now?
I turn back and walk to Rillford Square again.
I ask Constable Bram if he remembers me.
